requirements.name: Educational credential assessment (ECA)
requirements.detail: Use a CNO-approved ECA service provider: World Education Service (WES), International Credential Assessment Service of Canada (ICAS), or International Credential Evaluation Service (ICES, BCIT). CNO must receive the education assessment report and the corresponding educational documents before you apply. CNO still accepts NNAS expedited reports prepared by CGFNS (now TruMerit).

requirements.name: Language proficiency (IELTS Academic / CELBAN / OET)
requirements.detail: Required if education/experience was not in English/French. CELBAN is nursing-specific.

requirements.name: CNO registration application
requirements.detail: Complete and submit the application to CNO yourself, once CNO has received your ECA report.

requirements.name: NCLEX-RN
requirements.detail: National licensure exam. Must be eligible via CNO before registering for the exam.

requirements.name: Evidence of practice / criminal record check
requirements.detail: Declaration and, where required, police record check.

notes: Language test must be valid at the registration decision, not merely at application — a common expiry collision when ECA/exam timelines slip. URL check 2026-09-13: https://www.cno.org/en/become-a-nurse/registration-requirements/internationally-educated-nurses/ and https://www.ncsbn.org/exams.htm returned 404 and were replaced with verified pages on the same domains. H7a 2026-09-13: CNO's outside-Canada guide does not mention NNAS, and its approved-ECA page (https://www.cno.org/become-a-nurse/approved-educational-credential-assessment-service-providers) lists WES, ICAS and ICES (BCIT), requires the ECA report to reach CNO before you apply (ECAs done before April 1, 2025 follow the provider's instructions), and says CNO still accepts NNAS expedited reports prepared by CGFNS/TruMerit.
